title: OppFi Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-16
summary: OppFi Inc., a fintech consumer lending company, filed an 8-K disclosing a Third Amendment to its revolving credit agreement and the termination of a total return swap (TRS) with Midtown Madison Management LLC. The TRS terminated on April 15, 2026 following repayment of a $75 million Gray Rock Credit Agreement. OppFi-LLC acquired the Gray Rock Receivables from the Gray Rock Borrower and borrowed approximately $46.5 million under its amended facility to fund the purchase.
key_points: Third Amendment to Second Amended and Restated Revolving Credit Agreement executed on April 10, 2026, adding Approved Bank Partner Originator States and modifying eligibility criteria
Termination of TRS with Midtown Madison affiliates on April 15, 2026, related to a $75 million revolving credit agreement
Gray Rock Credit Agreement fully repaid, eliminating the reference pool of consumer receivables
OppFi-LLC borrowed approximately $46.5 million under the Amended Credit Agreement to purchase Gray Rock Receivables
No termination penalties incurred for TRS termination
Gray Rock Receivables were pledged as collateral under the Amended Credit Agreement following purchase
why_it_matters: This is an internal corporate financing disclosure for a small-cap fintech company (OppFi Inc., trading on NYSE as OPFI). The filing addresses routine credit facility amendments and TRS termination—standard corporate actions with no implications for broader financial markets, monetary policy, or market structure.

$46.5 million — borrowing under Amended Credit Agreement for Gray Rock Receivables purchase
